bottlenecks_identified: THREE 17TH-CONSECUTIVE LEGACY CARRYOVERS (Exp 786/627/603): cumulative waste now ~1,879 min (31.3 hours) just from these three experiments across 17 milestones. Exclusion manifest unapplied for 17 consecutive milestones — the longest-running unresolved governance failure in the project history.

EXP 641 (HermesVerifierAdapter v2): 7th consecutive slow appearance, 4 milestones past the CLAUDE.md mandatory-gate threshold. No root-cause documentation produced in any appearance. Each occurrence consumes 42 min with unknown yield.

EXP 906 (IterativeSelfRepair 50q): 4th consecutive slow appearance, 1 milestone past mandatory gate. SOTA GGUF pre-download fix deferred across 4 consecutive milestones despite being a known, diagnosed cause.

DUALGPU NOT WIRED: 11th consecutive idle milestone post-deployment. DualGPURunner benchmarked at 1.96-2.02x throughput (Exps 684/685, 932). Cumulative foregone savings now ~660 min (11 hours). Both RTX 3090s idle at 0%/52C at close.

COMPOSITION FREEZE FOURTH CONSECUTIVE: slowest-5 composition unchanged for four consecutive milestones (.73, .74, .75, .76). This directly mirrors the .60-.70 11-milestone frozen-composition streak that produced ~2,760 min of preventable waste. Entering the same structural failure mode.

ENVPROPAGATIONGUARD RECURRENCE: Exp 975 blocked despite RETRO-015 being nominally closed in .66. EnvPropagation context does not persist across conductor sessions — Exp 975 is the 6th experiment blocked by this root cause across two milestones (.75: 5 experiments, .76: 1 experiment). Fix must be made session-boundary-persistent.

IMPROVEMENT DECELERATING: fifth consecutive improvement but at -43 min, down from -213 min in .75. The improvement is again count-driven (-14 experiments), not structural. If count stabilizes at the 648 level, the streak terminates automatically.

DOC RECONCILIATION PASSES: per-experiment in-process reconciliation runs serially for each of the 648 experiments. Estimated 20 min/milestone recoverable via mid-milestone + end-of-milestone batching.

SC-ENERGY TIER 2 DEPLOYMENT BLOCKED: 3 test failures block production deployment as of .75 planning. Test failure root cause not addressed in .76 (SC-Energy visible in Exp 976 result but Tier 2 deployment status unclear without reading that artifact).
improvements_suggested: IMMEDIATE (before .77): Add Exp 786, Exp 627, and Exp 603 to ops/exclusion_manifest.yaml. This single governance action eliminates ~172 min of structural waste per milestone. It has been recommended for 17 consecutive milestones. Without this, all wall-time improvements remain count-driven and fragile.

IMMEDIATE: Document Exp 641 (HermesVerifierAdapter v2) root cause from results artifact. Apply CARNOT_EXPERIMENT_TIMEOUT_MINUTES=30 cap or retire to exclusion_manifest.yaml. Four milestones past mandatory gate — further deferral is a process violation.

IMMEDIATE: Pre-download Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-GGUF, Gemma-4-31B-it-GGUF, Gemma-4-26B-A4B-it-GGUF at milestone start before any experiment runs. Apply CARNOT_EXPERIMENT_TIMEOUT_MINUTES=40 cap to Exp 906. This is the fourth consecutive milestone with the same diagnosed root cause.

FIX ENVPROPAGATIONGUARD PERSISTENCE: Env propagation context must survive conductor session boundaries. The Exp 855 fix (RETRO-015 close) patches the in-session state but does not persist to new sessions. Fix: write CARNOT_FORCE_LIVE=1 to a conductor state file at session start, sourced by each experiment subprocess. Until fixed, GPU-required experiments will be blocked in any milestone that starts a new conductor session.

WIRE DUALGPU: Integrate DualGPURunner into VerifyRepairPipeline production path. This task has been explicitly deferred for 11 consecutive milestones. At 1.96-2.02x GPU throughput, the saving is ~60 min/milestone on GPU-bound experiments. Assign as a .77 hard prerequisite, not an optional task.

ADD EXPERIMENT TIMEOUT WATCHDOG: Apply CARNOT_EXPERIMENT_TIMEOUT_MINUTES=30 globally (per-experiment override allowed). Prevents overrun waste in the Exp 603/641 class. Estimated savings: 26 min/milestone.
DOC RECONCILIATION BATCHING: Batch all in-process doc reconciliation into two checkpoints (mid-milestone, end-of-milestone) rather than per-experiment. Estimated savings: 20 min/milestone.

BATCH INFERENCE ENFORCEMENT: Enforce batch_size=8-16 for all GPU inference calls per ExperimentTemplate contract. GPU monitor recommends DualGPURunner at every close. Single-process serial inference wastes both GPUs.

BREAK COMPOSITION FREEZE: If the slowest-5 composition is unchanged in .77, the fourth-consecutive-freeze pattern will reach the .60-.70 streak length in five more milestones. The only structural break is exclusion_manifest enforcement. Automate a pre-flight check: if any slowest-5 experiment from the prior three milestones appears in the .77 roadmap without a documented root-cause entry, block it.
